source_message.text: Okay. There’s one detail I forgot to bring up that occurred to me later. In the attached image of the matcha mixer, there is no actual way to pour the matcha. I’d like to add a spout at the bottom that faces the barista and makes pouring easy.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I understand the whisker concern and will locate a more appropriate component. Regarding the spout, the design in your image is possible, but it would involve custom work, another round of rethinking, and custom circuitry. We would essentially need a solenoid that opens and closes a valve inside the dispensing mechanism, allowing matcha to flow from that type of spout on demand. Developing a reliable mechanism and solution would require custom mechanical parts, wiring, and some r&d. It would probably extend beyond the timeline for this 1st edition. There are multiple off-the-shelf spout alternatives; might one of those work?

ambiguity.description: The desired render-like custom spout may require substantial custom engineering, leaving the choice between that configuration and an off-the-shelf alternative unresolved.
